title: Electric Field r < r0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the electric field for r < r0 as E1(r) = (rho0 * r) / (2 * epsilon0).

title: Electric Field r > r0 + Δr
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the electric field for r > r0 + Δr as E2(r) = (rho0 * r0^2) / (2 * r * epsilon0).

title: Electric Field r0 < r < r0 + Δr
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the electric field for r0 < r < r0 + Δr is E3(r) = 0.

title: Surface Charge Density r0
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the surface charge density at r = r0 as sigma(r0) = -(rho0 * r0) / 2.

title: Surface Charge Density r0 + Δr
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the surface charge density at r = r0 + Δr as sigma(r0 + Δr) = (rho0 * r0^2) / (2 * (r0 + Δr)).

title: Grounded Cylinder Fields
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly state that if the cylinder is grounded, E = 0 for r > r0 + Δr and sigma(r0 + Δr) = 0.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the surface charge density calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
